market.question: Will the highest temperature in San Francisco be between 60-61°F on May 5?

assessment.reasoning: San Francisco early May normal high ~67°F; forecasts indicate range 62-76°F across the month. The 60-61°F bucket is below normal — corresponds to a slightly cooler/marine-layer day. Without a more specific forecast for May 5, probability of high landing exactly at 60-61 is modest (~15-20%).
assessment.key_uncertainty: Marine layer/onshore flow strength on May 5 — small forecast errors make exact 1-degree bucket uncertain.
